CREATE TABLE safety_alerts (
    robot_id VARCHAR(255),
    alert_message VARCHAR(255)
);

WITH safety_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.effectivenessrobot AS robot_id,
        (
            10 * (CASE 
                    WHEN ps.safety_metrics->>'safety_state' = 'Emergency' THEN 0
                    WHEN ps.safety_metrics->>'safety_state' = 'Warning' THEN 5
                    WHEN ps.safety_metrics->>'safety_state' = 'Normal' THEN 10
                END) +
            5 * (CASE 
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'load_value'::FLOAT > 80 THEN 0
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'load_value'::FLOAT BETWEEN 50 AND 80 THEN 5
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'load_value'::FLOAT < 50 THEN 10
                END) +
            5 * (CASE 
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'memory_usage'::FLOAT > 80 THEN 0
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'memory_usage'::FLOAT BETWEEN 50 AND 80 THEN 5
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'memory_usage'::FLOAT < 50 THEN 10
                END) +
            5 * (CASE 
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'thermal_level'::FLOAT > 80 THEN 0
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'thermal_level'::FLOAT BETWEEN 50 AND 80 THEN 5
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'thermal_level'::FLOAT < 50 THEN 10
                END) +
            5 * (CASE 
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'cabinet_humidity'::FLOAT > 70 THEN 0
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'cabinet_humidity'::FLOAT BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 5
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'cabinet_humidity'::FLOAT < 50 THEN 10
                END) +
            5 * (CASE 
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'cabinet_temperature'::FLOAT > 40 THEN 0
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'cabinet_temperature'::FLOAT BETWEEN 25 AND 40 THEN 5
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'cabinet_temperature'::FLOAT < 25 THEN 10
                END
        ) AS safety_score
    FROM 
        performance_and_safety ps
    JOIN 
        system_controller sc ON ps.effectivenessrobot = sc.systemoverseerrobot
),
high_concern_robots AS (
    SELECT 
        robot_id,
        safety_score
    FROM 
        safety_scores
    WHERE 
        safety_score < 50
)
INSERT INTO safety_alerts (robot_id, alert_message)
SELECT 
    hcr.robot_id, 
    CONCAT('High Safety Concern for robot ', hcr.robot_id, ' with safety score: ', hcr.safety_score)
FROM 
    high_concern_robots hcr;
